title: KM VMS 0.8.3 — Unified UI Feedback and Atomic Update Rollback Safety
summary: Unifies compact confirmations and transient feedback across the UI, and adds atomic staged release activation with restart-safe convergence, exact automatic rollback and bounded cleanup.
changelog: Unifies compact application confirmations across affected operator actions without duplicating technical detail.
Standardizes transient operation feedback to one centered presentation, severity style and 2.5-second timeout.
Prepares the exact trusted target source and immutable images outside the active runtime before activation.
Activates a release through one atomic slot pointer and verifies target health and release identity.
Automatically restores the exact previous runtime when target health or identity verification fails.
Converges restart or interruption from one durable activation journal without replaying completed schema mutation.
Recovers safely from pointer-switch exceptions before or after the actual atomic replacement.
Cleans only old unprotected product slots, release image references and exact terminal-request staging.
Runs setup-helper and nested storage or restart scripts from the selected active release with stable-root bootstrap fallback.
Preserves shared .env, PostgreSQL, Redis, recordings, data and archive-root mounts outside release slots.
